$comment: Crew radio script, one entry per line id. 'role' picks the speaking voice (commander = voice A; gunner/loader/driver = voice B). 'delivery' is the ElevenLabs v4 audio-tag direction (English, prefixed in brackets at generation time). 'en-US' is the master; every other language is an idiomatic military rendering, not a literal translation. Keep takes short: crew radio, 1-6 words.

lines.context: Battle begins, countdown reached zero.
Our tank starts moving for the first time this battle.
Our team won the battle.
ja: 勝利だ！よくやった、みんな！

lines.context: Our team lost the battle.
sv: Det är över. Vi är slagna.

lines.context: Battle ended in a draw.
en-GB: Cease fire. We'll call it a draw.
ja: 撃ち方やめ。引き分けだ。

lines.context: Our crew spotted a new enemy vehicle.
New enemy contact directly ahead of our hull.
New enemy contact to our left.
New enemy contact to our right.
New enemy contact behind us.
The enemy has spotted our tank.
Our gunner fires the main gun.
We launched a guided missile.
Our shell penetrated the enemy armor.
Our shell hit but did not penetrate.
fr: Aucun effet, le blindage a tenu !
it: Nessun danno, la corazza ha retto!

lines.context: Our shell glanced off the enemy armor.
Our hit damaged an enemy module or crew.
Our hit set the enemy vehicle on fire.
Our hit struck the enemy ammunition.
en-US: Ammo rack hit! They're cooking off!
ja: 弾薬庫に命中！誘爆するぞ！
it: Colpite le munizioni! Salta in aria!
pl: Trafiliśmy w amunicję! Wylatuje w powietrze!

lines.context: We destroyed an enemy vehicle.
Our shell missed the target.
Loader starts a long reload.
Main gun is loaded and ready.
Switching to armor-piercing kinetic rounds (APFSDS / AP).
Switching to HEAT rounds.
Switching to high-explosive rounds.
Switching to the guided missile.
Ammunition is running low.
The selected ammunition type is used up.
An enemy shell penetrated our armor.
An enemy shell hit us but did not penetrate.
Our tank is critically damaged.
en-GB: We can't take much more of this!
de: Viel halten wir nicht mehr aus!

lines.context: Our own ammunition storage was hit.
Our fuel tank was hit.
Our tank is on fire.
en-GB: Fire, fire, fire! Put it out!

lines.context: The fire on our tank is out.
Our engine is damaged.
ja: エンジン被弾、出力低下！

lines.context: Our engine stopped completely.
Our transmission is damaged.
A track was broken; we cannot move.
Our main gun is damaged.
Our turret ring is damaged; traverse is slow.
Our gun mount is damaged.
Our autoloader is damaged; reloads are slower.
The weapon feed system is damaged.
Our roof machine gun is knocked out.
Our missile launcher rack is damaged.
Our sights/optics are damaged.
en-US: I can't see through the sights!
en-GB: Can't see a thing through the sight!
zh: 瞄准镜里什么都看不见！
fr: Je ne vois rien au viseur !

lines.context: Our radio is damaged.
Our commander was wounded.
en-GB: Commander's been hit! I have command!
fr: Chef touché ! Je prends le commandement !
ja: 車長被弾！指揮を引き継ぐ！
it: Capocarro colpito! Prendo io il comando!

lines.context: Our gunner was wounded.
Our driver was wounded.
Our loader was wounded.
Repairs finished with the repair kit.
First aid kit used; wounded crew recovered.
fr: Tout le monde est sur pied !

lines.context: Broken track repaired.
Main gun repaired.
Engine repaired.
We trigger the fire extinguisher.
We fire our smoke grenade launchers.
A friendly tank nearby was destroyed.
fr: On a perdu un des nôtres !

lines.context: We are the last surviving tank on our team.
en-US: We're the last ones. Make it count!
en-GB: Last callsign standing. Make it count!
de: Nur noch wir. Jeder Schuss muss sitzen!
fr: On est les derniers. Chaque obus compte !
sv: Bara vi kvar. Varje skott ska sitta!
ja: 残るは我々だけだ。一発も無駄にするな！
ko: 우리만 남았다. 한 발 한 발 정확히!
it: Siamo gli ultimi. Ogni colpo conta!
pl: Zostaliśmy sami. Każdy strzał musi trafić!

lines.context: Our team captured an objective zone.
The enemy captured an objective zone.
Our team picked up the enemy flag.
The enemy picked up our flag.
Our team scored a flag capture.
Our flag was returned to base.
A new enemy wave is attacking.
The enemy wave was defeated.
en-US: That's the last of them... for now.
sv: Det var de sista... för nu.
ja: これで全部か……今のところは。

lines.context: The front line advanced in our favor.
Our team scored a goal in the ball mode.
We respawned into the battle.
We collected a supply pickup.
Our shot hit a friendly tank by mistake.
de: Feuer halt! Das ist ein Eigener!
fr: Halte au feu ! C'est un ami !
sv: Eld upphör! Det är en egen!
it: Cessate il fuoco! È uno dei nostri!

lines.context: A friendly tank's shell hit us.
We collided with a friendly tank.
de: Langsam, das ist einer von uns!
sv: Lugnt, det är en av våra!
ja: 落ち着け、味方の車両だ！

lines.context: An enemy tank rammed us.
A teammate destroyed an enemy vehicle.
fr: Les nôtres en ont eu un !

lines.context: We destroyed a second enemy within seconds.
Only one enemy vehicle remains.
sv: En kvar! Gör slut på honom!
ja: 敵は残り一両！仕留めろ！

lines.context: The enemy has far more tanks left than our team.
Several new enemy contacts at once.
A guided missile is flying at us.
sv: Robot mot oss, håll i er!
ja: 誘導弾が来る、衝撃に備えろ！

lines.context: An enemy shell just missed us.
Our tank rolled over.
en-GB: We've gone over on our side!

lines.context: Our tank is upright again.
We drove into deep water.
The tracks can't get traction; we're stuck.
The gun can't depress or elevate any further.
The fire-control system locked onto a target.
We lost our locked target.
Our hit broke the enemy's track.
Our hit damaged the enemy's main gun.
fr: Son canon est hors de combat !
it: Il suo cannone è fuori uso!

lines.context: Our hit wounded the enemy crew.
Our hit damaged the enemy's engine.
All ammunition is gone.
en-GB: Bins are empty, no ammo left!

lines.context: Enemies are contesting an objective we hold.
de: Die machen uns den Punkt streitig!
